thread:
matt_sales: Hey team — Acme Reseller (MergeFlow) just asked for a joint POC plan. They need telemetry export, SLA language for co-sell, and clarity on pricing/entitlements. Can we sync? :wave:

lina_se: I can own architecture + runbook. Key Qs: is this hosted API usage or Dedicated reserved capacity for their customers? That changes egress/tenant wiring and telemetry path. :thinking_face:

acme_poc: From our side we expect mixed usage — most customers will use hosted but a couple enterprise pilots may want Dedicated. Primary ask: central telemetry to their Splunk and per-tenant metrics for billing. Also need a security questionnaire answered before legal.

aj_ops: For telemetry we can stream per-tenant metrics to a partner-facing Kinesis/Firehose or push to Splunk HTTP Event Collector. Short config example for a partner stream: 

```
# example firehose config
partner_stream:
  provider: firehose
  destination: prod-mergeflow-we
  auth_role: arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/redwood-telemetry
```

This keeps billing tags and tenant_id in the payload.

priya_security: Security checklist — we need to complete: SCC questionnaire, data residency mapping, KMS key policy for partner exports, and proof of pen-test within last 12 months. I'll take the questionnaire and push answers. Any specific items from MergeFlow?

acme_poc: We flagged: encryption at rest + in transit, separation of customer data, and SOC2 / ISO attestations. Also whether we support bringing-your-own-key for Dedicated.

lina_se: BYOK is supported for Private/Dedicated via KMS integration. For hosted we'll provide a partner-facing export pipeline with RBAC and per-tenant filters. I'll draft an architecture diagram and a minimal runbook (tenant provisioning, entitlement mapping, failover). ETA EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

matt_sales: Great. On pricing — MergeFlow wants a simple chargeback model: per-tenant monthly seat + p99 token metric for high-usage tenants. We should propose two options: 1) Hosted per-token + 2) Dedicated flat reservation with overage at lower per-token. Lina, can you include recommended SKU mapping so AP/Rev can translate?

aj_ops: Yup. Also call out autoscale burst rules: for Dedicated we do a reserved capacity block + burst pool. Example policy snippet: 

```
autoscale:
  reserved_units: 100
  burst_pool: 50
  cooldown: 120
```
We should note latency SLOs when bursting.

priya_security: I'll attach the SCC answers and a KMS policy template. For BYOK — require offline exchange and audit logs into partner SIEM. I'll also include minimum encryption cipher suites we support.

deploy-bot: Deployment triggered: telemetry-proxy:v2 -> staging (by lina_se) — build 2026.03.22-874.

acme_poc: Thanks, folks. For timeline: legal needs the security responses by Thurs and our ops wants the telemetry runbook + sample payload within 48h. Can you confirm?

matt_sales: Confirmed. Priya will post sec Q by Thu morning; Lina will share runbook + sample payload within 48h. Aj will provide the autoscale/pricing knobs for the proposal. I'll update MergeFlow and loop in finance. :thumbsup:

lina_se: Quick sample payload for partner Splunk ingestion (JSON): 

```
{
  "tenant_id": "mergeflow-cust-123",
  "request_id": "req-4b9e",
  "model": "gpt-4o-infer",
  "tokens": 412,
  "latency_ms": 134,
  "timestamp": "2026-03-22T14:12:01Z"
}
```
Use that for billing hooks.

aj_ops: One blocker to flag: if the partner wants per-tenant export and they onboard 1000 small tenants, we need to recommend a pooled export with tagging rather than 1000 separate connections — ops complexity and cost. I'll add that to the runbook.

priya_security: Adding note — for per-tenant telemetry we must redact any PII fields in the payload. We'll provide a sanitizer lambda snippet in the runbook.

matt_sales: Perfect. Next steps: priya_security -> post SCC answers, lina_se -> runbook + diagram + sample payload, aj_ops -> autoscale/pricing knobs, i'll coordinate finance and legal. Check back here once artifacts are posted and i'll schedule a 30m sync with MergeFlow on Friday. :calendar:  

acme_poc: Appreciated. Will prep legal intake form on our end.

lina_se: Uploading runbook draft now -> https://redwood.internal/s/mergeflow-runbook (will push public link after review). :eyes:

priya_security: Uploaded SCC responses and KMS template -> https://redwood.internal/security/mergeflow-scc. Marking critical items in doc.

matt_sales: Thanks team — keeping this thread for final signoff.
